info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Assignments Logs API

params.name: id
params.description: An UUID representing the assignment id.

items.docs:
Get an assignment by id with all its logs. The assignment will be visible if:
  • the current user is regular and the assignment is assigned to him or his teams
  • the current user is queue manager and and the assignment has an assignee in the current branch or child branches

params.name: subjectId
params.description: A string representing a subject id ( usually a document UUID ).

params.name: page
params.description: Number representing the page to be return from the paginated result-set.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of assignments displayed per page.

items.docs:
Get a paged list of assignments with all their logs, filtered by subject id which usually is a document id.
The assignments will be visible if:
  • the current user is regular and the assignments are assigned to him or his teams
  • the current user is queue manager and and the assignments have an assignee in the current branch or child branches
